title: 2 Keys Keyboard
summary: Starting with one 'A' on the screen, you can copy all characters and then paste them to increase the count.
statement: Starting with one 'A' on the screen, you can copy all characters and then paste them to increase the count. Determine the minimum operations needed to display exactly n 'A's.
constraints: Start with one A; Copy All and Paste each cost one operation.
hints: A copy followed by pastes multiplies the current count by an integer factor.
Break n into prime factors; each factor costs that many operations.
Repeatedly divide n by its smallest factors and add each factor.
Splitting a composite multiplier a*b costs a+b, never more than the unsplit cost a*b, so prime factors are optimal.
editorial: Splitting a composite multiplier a*b costs a+b, never more than the unsplit cost a*b, so prime factors are optimal.
